title: Scripture as seed that grows into a tree
english: Every word of divine Scripture seems to me like seed. Cast into the earth it is born again and multiplies. This word, if it finds a skilled farmer, grows into a tree — [[like a mustard seed >> Bible:Matthew 13:31-32]]. By your prayers may the word of God be present.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.
After Genesis SERIES CLOSEOUT 270ab13a; Hexateuch continuation.

title: Names of Israel’s sons who entered Egypt
english: [[These are the names of the sons of Israel who entered Egypt with Jacob >> Bible:Exodus 1:1-5]]; seventy-five souls. Egypt is the world into which God’s people descend to sojourn. There is [[Israel according to the flesh >> Bible:1 Corinthians 10:18]] and according to the spirit; [[a true Israelite in whom is no guile >> Bible:John 1:47]].
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.
After Genesis SERIES CLOSEOUT 270ab13a; Hexateuch continuation.

title: Each house enters; Joseph already in Egypt
english: Each with his whole house: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah. [[Joseph was in Egypt and took a wife from there >> Bible:Genesis 41:45; Exodus 1:5]], yet remains in the patriarchs’ number. The houses are generations of the soul entering the world.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.
After Genesis SERIES CLOSEOUT 270ab13a; Hexateuch continuation.

title: Letter without culture vs spiritual tillage
english: Whoever follows only the history of the names leaves the seed untilled. Whoever works it with spiritual skill becomes a tree — not verbal pomp, but a way of living. The names mark beginnings of the virtues in the soul.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.
After Genesis SERIES CLOSEOUT 270ab13a; Hexateuch continuation.

title: Descent and increase — Homilia I CLOSEOUT
english: The reading at Exodus’s opening holds the descent into Egypt and the increase. We pursue as much as edifies. This is Homily I’s close — from the word’s seed as far as the mystery of Egypt and the true Israel. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.
